name: Freeze sticker
description: The picture freezes, the speaker lifts off as a sticker with a thick white outline over a blurred, darker background, a name tag pops on, then the live footage goes on.
when: The first time you introduce yourself or a guest, or a beat where you want to stop and point at the person.
needs: the cut time where it starts
a sharp frame to freeze on
a cutout of that frame (made in step 3)
